notes: These 44 sermons defined Methodist doctrine and were required reading for all Methodist preachers. Sermon 3 was authored by Charles Wesley, not John.

sermons.title: Salvation by Faith
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The nature of saving faith — not intellectual assent but living trust
sermons.summary: Wesley's first published sermon after Aldersgate. Distinguishes saving faith from mere historical belief. Faith as divine gift, not human achievement.

sermons.title: The Almost Christian
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The difference between outward religion and the transformed heart
sermons.summary: Preached at Oxford before the University. Devastating self-examination: one can be morally upright, religiously observant, and still miss the essential thing.

sermons.title: Awake, Thou That Sleepest
sermons.author: Charles Wesley
sermons.theme: The spiritual sleep of the unconverted and the urgent call to awaken
sermons.summary: The only sermon in the 44 written by Charles. Preached at Oxford. The poet's voice distinct from John's — more vivid, more dramatic, more urgent in imagery.

sermons.title: Scriptural Christianity
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: What Christianity looks like when the Spirit fills it — and the devastating implication for Oxford
sermons.summary: Preached at Oxford, ended Wesley's welcome there. Concluded by asking where scriptural Christianity could be found — implying the University itself had none.

sermons.title: Justification by Faith
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The forensic act of God declaring the ungodly righteous through faith
sermons.summary: Wesley's careful definition of justification — pardon, not transformation (that is sanctification). Responds to Calvinist critics.

sermons.title: The Righteousness of Faith
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The contrast between the righteousness of the law and the righteousness of faith

sermons.title: The Way to the Kingdom
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The kingdom of God is not outward observance but inward transformation

sermons.title: The First-Fruits of the Spirit
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: No condemnation — the first-fruits of the Spirit's work in the believer

sermons.title: The Spirit of Bondage and Adoption
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Three states: natural, legal (under fear), evangelical (spirit of adoption)
sermons.summary: One of Wesley's most psychologically acute sermons — maps the inner journey from natural ignorance through legal fear to the freedom of adoption.

sermons.title: The Witness of the Spirit I
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The direct witness of the Spirit to our adoption — not inference but immediate testimony

sermons.title: The Witness of the Spirit II
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Assurance confirmed by the indirect witness — the fruit of the Spirit in life
sermons.summary: Written 21 years after Sermon 10, this is Wesley's mature refinement: direct witness of the Spirit confirmed by indirect witness of transformed character.

sermons.title: The Witness of Our Own Spirit
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The human spirit's testimony to itself — conscience as secondary witness

sermons.title: On Sin in Believers
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The remains of sin in the regenerate heart — and why this requires ongoing sanctification
sermons.summary: Against both Calvinist despair (sin always remains dominant) and antinomian triumphalism (sin is gone at conversion). The believer is genuinely new but not yet fully sanctified.

sermons.title: The Repentance of Believers
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Repentance is not only for conversion — believers need continual repentance

sermons.title: The Great Assize
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The final judgment — every soul accountable before the great tribunal
sermons.summary: Preached at the assizes (legal court). Wesley turns the occasion into a meditation on the divine court that supersedes all human courts.

sermons.title: The Means of Grace
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The outward channels through which God ordinarily works inward grace
sermons.summary: Against the 'stillness' movement (Moravians who said wait passively for grace). Wesley argues the means of grace — prayer, Scripture, Communion — are God's appointed channels.

sermons.title: The Circumcision of the Heart
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The inward holiness God requires — the cutting away of every self-centered disposition
sermons.summary: Earliest sermon in the collection, preached before Aldersgate. Shows Wesley already grasping inward holiness. The pre-conversion man who intellectually possessed what he did not yet experientially know.

sermons.title: The Marks of the New Birth
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Three marks identify the new birth: faith, hope, and love

sermons.title: The Great Privilege of Those that are Born of God
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The regenerate do not habitually commit sin — and what happens when they do

sermons.title: The Lord Our Righteousness
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Christ is our righteousness — both imputed (justification) and imparted (sanctification)

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount I
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The Beatitudes as the foundation of the Christian life

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount II
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount III
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount IV
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount V
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Christ fulfills but does not abolish the moral law — Wesley's defense against antinomianism

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount VI
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount VII
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount VIII
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount IX
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount X
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount XI
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount XII
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount XIII
sermons.author: John Wesley

sermons.title: The Original, Nature, Properties and Use of the Law
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The moral law: its origin in God's own nature, its properties, and its three uses

sermons.title: The Law Established through Faith I
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Faith does not abolish the law but establishes it — against antinomian teaching

sermons.title: The Law Established through Faith II
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Preaching the law and preaching the gospel are not opposed — both establish each other

sermons.title: The Nature of Enthusiasm
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: True religion and false enthusiasm — Wesley's defense of rational Christianity
sermons.summary: Critical sermon. Wesley navigates between dead formalism and wild fanaticism. 'Enthusiasm' was the 18th century term for unbalanced religious experience.

sermons.title: A Caution Against Bigotry
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Do not forbid those who do God's work outside our group
sermons.summary: Wesley's most ecumenical sermon. Uses the disciples' complaint about the unknown exorcist to argue against sectarian restriction of God's work.

sermons.title: Catholic Spirit
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Though we cannot think alike, can we not love alike?
sermons.summary: Perhaps Wesley's most famous single line. Distinguishes opinions (where diversity is acceptable) from the catholic spirit of love (which must unite all Christians).

sermons.title: Christian Perfection
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: What Christian perfection is — and equally, what it is not
sermons.summary: Wesley's defining theological contribution. Perfect love: freedom from deliberate sin, pure motivation, complete love for God and neighbor. Not freedom from mistakes, ignorance, or infirmity.

sermons.title: Wandering Thoughts
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: What are wandering thoughts, which are sinful, and how to bring them into captivity

sermons.title: Satan's Devices
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The enemy's tactics against believers — that we might not be ignorant of his devices

sermons.title: The Scripture Way of Salvation
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: Wesley's mature synthesis: what salvation is, and the faith by which we receive it
sermons.summary: Often called Wesley's greatest single sermon. Written at 62, it distills a lifetime of preaching into a clear, balanced account of salvation from its beginning to entire sanctification.

sermons.title: Original Sin
sermons.author: John Wesley
sermons.theme: The total corruption of human nature apart from grace
sermons.summary: Against the optimistic Deism of the age. Wesley insists on radical human corruption as the context that makes grace necessary and glorious.
